title: Veneer glued on plastic. Totally functional, but very basic.
text:
Veneer glued on plastic. Totally functional, but very basic.. RealVeneer is what the description and name ought to say rather than wood. I mean, technically, there is wood here, but it's just a wafer thin sheet glued on the bottom of the plastic tray. Like the thin roll out veneers over that cheap throw-away desk we all had in our freshman college dorm. Nonetheless, the tray in totality is perfectly functional.

It fits on the back of our guest toilet and holds a couple of extra rolls of toilet paper, a wipes container and two bottles of the Poo Pourri spray. My theory is that the items one might need ought to be handy and not hidden or hard to access....It is the bathroom after all. The lip on this tray is deep enough to keep everything from in place.
